verdict.rationale: Airbyte's Connection Timeline shows historical connection events and lets you view and download logs and find errors per sync. Its built-in notification system sends alerts to email, a webhook, or both, which covers the alerting channels in the story. Missing for 10: no evidence of per-sync row/record counts, no explicit native Slack integration (only webhook), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the monitoring and alerting experience.
